run_evaluate: run the full evaluation of a signal processing program file and return composite scores
run_evaluate_stage1: run a quick stage 1 validation that the signal processing program runs without errors
run_evaluate_stage2: run the full stage 2 evaluation with all test signals on a program file
calculate_composite_score: calculate the weighted composite metric from slope changes, lag error, average error, and false reversals
generate_test_signals: generate multiple noisy and clean test signal pairs with varying characteristics for evaluation
